dispositions.rationale: Integral divisions improve MIDI compatibility but fractional positive values remain allowed.
dispositions.closure: Retain as optional compatibility guidance; preserve fractional positive values. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Number distinguishes overlapping same-kind objects in part document order, with element-specific exceptions.
dispositions.produces: Span identity includes part, element kind, document-order overlap, and effective number where its default is defined.
dispositions.closure: Enumerate element-specific number defaults and the tied exception before finalizing the identity contract. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A stop can precede its start in XML because musical order differs from document order.
dispositions.closure: Keep this as anti-overconstraint guidance and reject a universal LIFO matching policy. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Start and stop identify musical endpoints rather than XML traversal order.
dispositions.produces: Each span endpoint has a musical start or stop role independent of its XML position.
dispositions.closure: Specify musical endpoint ordering across staves and include a stop-before-start example. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Musical ordering of same-kind span elements on one note is recommended rather than mandatory.
dispositions.closure: Keep same-note ordering as an advisory with no unconditional validity failure. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Continue identifies an intermediate span point without changing the musical meaning of start and stop.
dispositions.produces: A continue endpoint belongs inside a musical span whose start and stop may appear in another XML order.
dispositions.closure: Separate musical sequence from XML sequence when reviewing continuation semantics. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Musical ordering of start-stop-single elements is recommended and single requires no pair.
dispositions.closure: Retain ordering guidance while excluding single endpoints from mandatory pairing. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: String numbering starts with the highest full-length string rather than the bottom staff line.
dispositions.produces: String 1 is the highest-pitched full-length string in the instrument string context.
dispositions.closure: Define the full-length-string scope without reusing staff-line numbering. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Tenths use global scaling and are unaffected by staff-size changes.
dispositions.produces: A tenth is one tenth of the global staff-space unit; fractional and negative values remain representable.
dispositions.closure: Keep global units distinct from staff-size and retain signed fractional coordinates. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Absent text direction has a specified left-to-right interpretation.
dispositions.produces: Effective text direction is ltr when absent; explicit lro or rlo overrides bidirectional ordering.
dispositions.closure: Document explicit-value precedence and the bidi override modes. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Let-ring denotes a sustained untamped sound using one visual tie endpoint.
dispositions.produces: A tied element of type let-ring is a complete single-ended notation and needs no start-stop partner.
dispositions.closure: Exclude let-ring from ordinary paired-tie assumptions. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A visual tie on one note is recommended as start then stop, with let-ring and navigation exceptions.
dispositions.closure: Retain same-note encoding advice with its let-ring and repeat or coda exceptions. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Missing fermata type and empty fermata shape have explicit graphical defaults.
dispositions.produces: Effective fermata type is upright when absent and its empty shape is normal.
dispositions.closure: Reconcile this fact with empty-fermata-normal to avoid duplicate default providers. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Unspecified text vertical alignment is intentionally chosen by the application.
dispositions.produces: Effective text valign is application-dependent unknown when no explicit value exists.
dispositions.closure: Represent an unresolved application choice without inventing an alignment or file defect. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: An image without explicit vertical alignment leaves that choice to the application.
dispositions.produces: Effective image valign is application-dependent unknown; baseline is outside the image alignment type.
dispositions.closure: Keep application choice separate from the schema exclusion of baseline. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A mid-measure key cancellation should treat before-barline as left, and an absent location means left.
dispositions.closure: Separate the recommended mid-measure interpretation from the unconditional absent-location default during review. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Print-object is preferred to deprecated sign=none, which remains permitted.
dispositions.closure: Preserve acceptance of none and keep its suggested treble rendering advisory. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Numeric fret rendering is the defined default while letters remain available.
dispositions.produces: Effective show-frets is numbers when absent.
dispositions.closure: Check explicit letter rendering overrides the numeric fallback. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Staff lines count upward from the bottom and positions outside the staff are permitted.
dispositions.produces: Staff line 1 is the bottom line; clef-line and staff-line-position are not bounded by the current line count.
dispositions.closure: Preserve outside-staff coordinates instead of deriving a 1-to-line-count restriction. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Staff numbers identify staves top to bottom within a part.
dispositions.produces: Staff 1 is the top staff of its part; positive lexical validity alone does not establish staff existence.
dispositions.closure: Keep numbering interpretation separate from any planned staff-reference predicate. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: An alternate staff is another view of the preceding staff rather than additional playback material.
dispositions.produces: An alternate staff inherits the preceding staff's music representation and contributes no extra playback stream.
dispositions.closure: Resolve the preceding staff within the part and preserve the advisory preference against duplicate parts. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: An unspecified staff type represents an ordinary staff.
dispositions.produces: Effective staff-type is regular when absent.
dispositions.closure: Distinguish the regular fallback from explicit cue, ossia, editorial, and alternate types. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Absent time-separator uses vertically arranged numerator and denominator.
dispositions.produces: Effective time-separator is none when absent; the time signature itself remains present.
dispositions.closure: Prevent none from being interpreted as absence of meter. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: An unspecified time-symbol uses normal notation without changing meter values.
dispositions.produces: Effective time-symbol is normal when absent; note and dotted-note affect display only.
dispositions.closure: Keep display-symbol selection separate from meter arithmetic. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Whitespace-only ending numbers express an existing ending whose number is unknown.
dispositions.produces: An empty or whitespace-only ending number yields unknown ending-number identity rather than a missing ending.
dispositions.closure: Preserve unknown numbering and do not impose a nonempty numeric-list rule. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Missing winged specifies an unwinged repeat barline.
dispositions.produces: Effective barline winged is none when absent.
dispositions.closure: Treat other values as graphical repeat-wing choices only. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Kind none explicitly removes harmonic meaning from accompanying root information.
dispositions.produces: A harmony with kind none denotes no harmony and its root, numeral, or function is semantically inactive.
dispositions.closure: Do not infer a requirement to compare this notation with sounding pitches. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: An empty root text is recommended to suppress printing for kind none, but the source names an absent numeral-step element.
dispositions.closure: Resolve the numeral-step versus numeral-root source discrepancy before offering a concrete advisory fix. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Unqualified minor has natural-minor meaning rather than an application-selected minor scale.
dispositions.produces: Mode or numeral-mode minor resolves to natural minor; harmonic minor raises VII and melodic minor raises VI and VII.
dispositions.closure: Limit this interpretation to the identified mode fields and explicit minor variants. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Change, continue, discontinue, and resume carry line-pedal semantics without proving a sound defect when no line is drawn.
dispositions.produces: The four identified pedal types are associated with line=yes graphical behavior.
dispositions.closure: Decide whether line applicability is a context-only condition or a separately justified predicate; do not infer playback invalidity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Extracted parts should show a system number once even when the score associates it with two positions.
dispositions.closure: Retain the single-part recommendation and scope top and bottom positions to the current system. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Extracted parts should render a system mark once and system none limits it to the current part.
dispositions.closure: Keep extraction advice distinct from the part-local meaning of system none. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Octave-shift direction describes written display relative to stored true pitch.
dispositions.produces: An octave-shift changes displayed pitch relative to note pitch; an upper 8va marking corresponds to down.
dispositions.closure: Do not transpose the sounding pitch a second time when applying display shifts. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Distance type is an extensible string rather than the list of examples.
dispositions.produces: Application-defined distance types remain representable alongside known appearance types.
dispositions.closure: Prevent a closed enumeration from being inferred from the examples. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Glyph type permits application extensions beyond the documented examples.
dispositions.produces: Glyph type has an open value domain with known semantic bindings where specified.
dispositions.closure: Keep known glyph bindings separate from an unsupported closed type enumeration. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Line-width type permits application-specific values.
dispositions.produces: Line-width type remains an open string domain beyond its listed examples.
dispositions.closure: Do not introduce a closed enumeration over the schema string. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Grace-cue, grace, and cue appearance categories depend on both note branch and cue-size status.
dispositions.produces: The grace-cue category applies to combined grace and cue; grace and cue size categories remain distinct from sounding behavior.
dispositions.closure: Resolve the source wording for grace cue-size categories against the explicit note-type size defaults before closing the category mapping. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: SMuFL note-name noteheads are better represented with notehead-text than other plus smufl.
dispositions.closure: Restrict the advisory to U+E150–U+E1AF and U+EEE0–U+EEFF without banning otherwise schema-valid markup. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: MusicXML octave 4 begins at middle C.
dispositions.produces: Pitch octave 4 denotes the octave beginning at middle C; the separate schema domain is 0 through 9.
dispositions.closure: Keep octave naming separate from its schema numeric restriction. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Alteration values are semitone quantities and may be fractional for microtones.
dispositions.produces: Pitch alter and the applicable related alteration fields express signed semitone offsets, including fractions.
dispositions.closure: Enumerate related fields without imposing integer or minus-two-to-two restrictions. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Implicit yes is preferred for hiding a measure number while empty measure text is independently schema-invalid.
dispositions.closure: Keep the export recommendation separate from the existing nonempty measure-text lexical contract. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Absent bend-sound attributes have fixed playback defaults.
dispositions.produces: Effective bend-sound defaults are accelerate=no, beats=4, first-beat=25, and last-beat=75, with percentages measured over duration.
dispositions.closure: Specify per-attribute explicit overrides and percentage duration basis. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Bezier x coordinates replace deprecated offset coordinates instead of adding to them.
dispositions.produces: Bezier-x overrides bezier-offset and bezier-x2 overrides bezier-offset2; x and y use global tenths while offsets use divisions.
dispositions.closure: Preserve separate units and coordinate precedence for both control points. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Dash and space lengths have no effect unless the line is dashed.
dispositions.produces: Dash-length and space-length are inactive when line-type is not dashed.
dispositions.closure: Represent inactive attributes without treating their presence as invalid. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Explicit horizontal positioning can override directive placement.
dispositions.produces: Default-x, justify, or halign overrides directive-based horizontal placement; otherwise the anchor is the time signature or first notational item.
dispositions.closure: Specify how the contextual anchor is selected when the time signature or first notational item is absent. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Absent score version is interpreted as 1.0 rather than the validator's target version.
dispositions.produces: The score's effective declared version is 1.0 when version is absent.
dispositions.closure: Keep export-version advice and the chosen validation profile separate from the absent-value interpretation. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: An unspecified font is a text font selected by the application.
dispositions.produces: The default font is application-dependent unknown in the text-font category.
dispositions.closure: Do not require a particular font or substitute a music font by default. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Halign can inherit justify, but the fallback depends on whether justify is applicable.
dispositions.produces: Absent halign uses applicable justify; when justify is unavailable the alignment is application-dependent unknown.
dispositions.closure: Specify behavior when justify is applicable but also unspecified; do not invent a universal justify default. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Explicit justify supplies both block and line alignment when halign is absent.
dispositions.produces: An explicit justify value sets horizontal block and line alignment unless halign explicitly separates the block alignment.
dispositions.closure: Do not generalize this conditional rule into a universal absent-justify default. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Letter spacing defaults to normal and numeric spacing is measured in em.
dispositions.produces: Effective letter-spacing is normal when absent; explicit numeric values are signed em quantities.
dispositions.closure: Preserve negative tracking as meaningful rather than invalid. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Unspecified editorial parentheses, bracket, and size are application choices.
dispositions.produces: Each missing editorial-display parentheses, bracket, or size value is application-dependent unknown.
dispositions.closure: Resolve explicit attributes individually without forcing application choices into document requirements. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Normal is the default line-height while its concrete magnitude is application-dependent.
dispositions.produces: Effective line-height is normal when absent, with unresolved application-selected magnitude.
dispositions.closure: Keep the suggested 100-to-120 range advisory and avoid a numeric default. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Default coordinates establish origins while relative coordinates offset contextual defaults.
dispositions.produces: Default-x and default-y determine contextual origins; relative-x and relative-y offset the resolved default position, and credits use the page's lower-left origin.
dispositions.closure: Enumerate the documented measure and part-name origin exceptions before claiming complete coordinate semantics. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: More precise default coordinates are preferred when both positioning mechanisms are supported.
dispositions.closure: Retain renderer guidance while interpreting relative offsets with placement, offset, and directive context. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Print-object has an explicit yes fallback.
dispositions.produces: Effective print-object is yes when absent for objects supporting that attribute.
dispositions.closure: Keep dependent print-dot, print-lyric, and print-leger defaults in their separate conditional providers. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Print-spacing only controls layout when the note, dots, and lyrics are all hidden.
dispositions.produces: Effective print-spacing defaults to yes and is active only when note, dot, and lyric rendering are all suppressed.
dispositions.closure: Compute all three effective visibility values before determining spacing activity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Missing print-dot and print-lyric follow note visibility while explicit values remain independent.
dispositions.produces: Absent print-dot and print-lyric resolve to no when print-object=no and to yes otherwise.
dispositions.closure: Apply explicit attribute values before the conditional visibility fallback. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Text rotation has a defined direction and pivot.
dispositions.produces: Positive text rotation is clockwise and negative rotation counterclockwise around the alignment point.
dispositions.closure: Use the resolved text alignment point as the rotation origin. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Playback defaults differ between ordinary trills and mordent variants.
dispositions.produces: General trill-sound defaults are start-note=upper, trill-step=whole, two-note-turn=none, accelerate=no, beats=4, second-beat=25, last-beat=75; mordents use main, 3, 12, and 24 for the corresponding overrides.
dispositions.closure: Verify exact attribute correspondence and mordent override scope against the pinned source before closing this compound provider. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Image proportions should be preserved with one dimension and independently scaled when both dimensions are supplied.
dispositions.closure: Retain the scaling recommendation and leave required source and MIME type validation to their schema contracts. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: New-system and new-page positions should agree between parts, with undefined results on disagreement.
dispositions.closure: Report disagreement only as an optional interoperability advisory, not a universal structural error. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Page labels apply only to explicit new pages and staff-layout supersedes old staff-spacing.
dispositions.produces: Page-number and blank-page are inactive unless new-page=yes; staff-layout overrides deprecated staff-spacing.
dispositions.closure: Resolve new-page before field activity and retain layout-over-spacing precedence. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Link attachment depends on following sibling traversal and optional descendant selection.
dispositions.produces: With neither element nor position, a link targets the next sibling; element selects within the next non-link, non-bookmark element and position is one-based only when element is supplied.
dispositions.closure: Specify descendant name matching and missing-target behavior before closing the attachment resolver. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Aligned partwise measures should use consistent labels but labels need not be numeric or unique.
dispositions.closure: Do not turn cross-part label consistency into numeric-only or within-part uniqueness requirements. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Implicit measures suppress printed numbering even when explicit text is present.
dispositions.produces: Effective implicit defaults to no; implicit=yes suppresses both number and text rendering for that measure.
dispositions.closure: Keep conventional pickup number zero separate from required suppression semantics. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Non-controlling measures need not share a left boundary with measures in other parts.
dispositions.produces: Effective non-controlling defaults to no; yes marks a part-local boundary that is not a cross-part controlling boundary.
dispositions.closure: Allow polymetric boundaries without requiring uniform measure alignment. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A coda symbol benefits from matching playback information when playback is intended.
dispositions.closure: Scope the recommendation to playback reliability and preserve notation-only documents without sound markup. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Dynamics placement depends on whether it belongs to a direction or a note.
dispositions.produces: Within direction, direction placement overrides dynamics placement; on a note, the dynamics element's own placement applies.
dispositions.closure: Resolve the parent context before choosing the effective placement. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A horizontal turn is unslashed by default.
dispositions.produces: Effective horizontal-turn slash is no when absent; yes adds a vertical stroke.
dispositions.closure: Restrict the fallback to horizontal turn forms supporting slash. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Empty fermata content denotes the normal shape and missing type means upright.
dispositions.produces: Empty fermata shape resolves to normal and missing fermata type resolves to upright.
dispositions.closure: Share the default provider with fermata-upright instead of duplicating independent obligations. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Fingering substitution and alternate default to no and fingering differs from pluck.
dispositions.produces: Effective fingering substitution and alternate are no when absent; on plucked instruments fingering identifies the stopping finger and pluck the plucking finger.
dispositions.closure: Separate the two defaults from the instrument-specific fingering interpretation. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Fret zero denotes an open string and fret one the first fret.
dispositions.produces: Fret numbering starts with the open string at zero and the first stopped fret at one.
dispositions.closure: Leave numeric domain validation to the schema and retain the open-string semantic distinction. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Reference editorial content is visual only and has explicit default reference and span type.
dispositions.produces: Level reference=yes has no playback effect; missing reference is no and missing type is single.
dispositions.closure: Apply the defaults without treating visual editorial content as a sounding instruction. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: MusicXML MIDI-unpitched numbering is one-based unlike common MIDI note numbers.
dispositions.produces: MIDI-unpitched values 1 through 128 correspond to MIDI note numbers 0 through 127 by subtracting one.
dispositions.closure: Keep conversion separate from the MusicXML lexical range check. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Pan and elevation use listener-relative angular coordinates.
dispositions.produces: Pan 0 is front, -90 left, +90 right, and ±180 rear; elevation 0 is level, +90 above, and -90 below.
dispositions.closure: Document both axes rather than reusing an arbitrary MIDI controller scale. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Name-display display-text has local enclosure and language defaults.
dispositions.produces: Within name-display, display-text defaults to enclosure=none and language=it.
dispositions.closure: Resolve the local language default without rewriting the user's text. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Play instructions have note-local or continuing scope according to their parent.
dispositions.produces: Play in note affects only that note; play in sound affects later notes in musical order.
dispositions.closure: Preserve the instrument-id recommendation separately from the parent-dependent scope. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A segno symbol benefits from matching playback information when playback is required.
dispositions.closure: Keep this as playback guidance and accept notation-only use without sound. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A barline wavy-line is recommended to use continue.
dispositions.closure: Retain should-level guidance without prohibiting other schema-permitted types. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Mid-measure attribute changes apply by musical position and staff scope.
dispositions.produces: Effective attributes at an event come from applicable changes in musical order rather than XML traversal alone.
dispositions.closure: Define same-position precedence and staff scope before implementing the state resolver. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Divisions supplies quarter-note timing units and durations already account for sounding tuplets.
dispositions.produces: One quarter note equals the current divisions value; note durations encode intended tuplet-adjusted sounding time.
dispositions.closure: Do not add the recommended MIDI compatibility limit 16383 as a mandatory bound. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A key without number applies across the part rather than only the first staff.
dispositions.produces: The effective key scope is every staff of the containing part unless number selects one staff.
dispositions.closure: Apply explicit staff selection before the all-staves fallback. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A part is single-staff unless its staff count is specified.
dispositions.produces: Effective staves is one when absent, with staff numbering from top to bottom.
dispositions.closure: Distinguish initial omission from retained state after an earlier explicit staff count. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: The instruments count describes instruments within a part and defaults to one.
dispositions.produces: Effective instruments count is one when absent in its applicable attribute context.
dispositions.closure: Distinguish count from score-part count and specify retained attribute-state behavior. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Beat-repeat endpoints are recommended except for repeats continuing to the part end.
dispositions.closure: Preserve stop as the first undisplayed beat and separately retain slashes=1 and use-dots=no defaults. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Cancel refers to the previous signature and cancellation can be implicit for C major or A minor.
dispositions.produces: Cancel's value denotes fifths of the cancelled key; a transition to C major or A minor can cancel without an explicit cancel element.
dispositions.closure: Use prior effective key state and do not require cancel on every change. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Clef defaults and active fields depend on additional status, measure position, and printing.
dispositions.produces: Clef number defaults to one; additional=yes disables line interpretation, and after-barline is inactive mid-measure.
dispositions.closure: Decompose number, additional-size applicability, after-barline activity, and system-print suppression into separately scoped facts. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Double adds octave doubling rather than replacing the primary pitch.
dispositions.produces: A double element adds a lower-octave doubling unless above=yes, which adds an upper-octave doubling.
dispositions.closure: Preserve the original sounding line when deriving the additional octave. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: For-part without number applies to all staves in the newly created part.
dispositions.produces: The effective for-part scope is all staves of the created part unless number selects one.
dispositions.closure: Do not expand this scope to every score-part in the source score. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A key signature is displayed at a system start unless its print-object suppresses it.
dispositions.produces: The effective key is eligible for system-start printing unless print-object=no.
dispositions.closure: Keep the rendering fact separate from any requirement to duplicate key elements in XML. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Hidden lines count for pitch and clef positioning but not for staff-layout spacing.
dispositions.produces: Hidden staff lines remain in clef-line and display-position coordinates and are excluded from layout line counts.
dispositions.closure: Define the two line-count views and the requirement that individual line-detail depends on staff-lines. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Measure-repeat endpoints are recommended except for repeats continuing to part end.
dispositions.closure: Preserve stop as the first ordinary measure, ignored stop text, and the slashes=1 fallback separately from endpoint advice. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Multiple-rest uses ordinary rendering by default and its content counts measures.
dispositions.produces: Effective multiple-rest use-symbols is no when absent; the element's value is the number of represented measures.
dispositions.closure: Do not infer a requirement to collapse all represented measures into one XML measure. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A multi-staff part defaults to a brace, and a partial symbol changes common barline coverage.
dispositions.produces: Effective part-symbol is brace when omitted for a multi-staff part; top-staff and bottom-staff delimit its coverage.
dispositions.closure: Resolve default barline coverage for partial symbols and endpoint omissions before finalizing the provider. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Slash dot rendering is active only without stems.
dispositions.produces: Effective slash use-stems is no when absent; use-dots applies only when use-stems=no, while yes displays rhythm without pitch.
dispositions.closure: Do not report inactive use-dots as a document error. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A hidden staff may retain its vertical space.
dispositions.produces: Effective staff print-object defaults to yes; print-object=no with print-spacing=yes preserves vertical staff space.
dispositions.closure: Resolve visibility and spacing independently for cutaway rendering. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Capo raises the open-string tuning by semitones while staff-tuning remains the non-capo basis.
dispositions.produces: Effective capo-adjusted open-string pitch equals staff-tuning pitch plus capo semitones.
dispositions.closure: Keep stored non-capo tuning distinct from the derived sounding tuning. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Staff-space size and notation-size scaling are separate percentages with application-chosen reduced defaults.
dispositions.produces: Staff-size scales interline spacing, while its scaling attribute separately scales notation; reduced cue, ossia, and editorial sizes are application-dependent unknown.
dispositions.closure: Specify both percentage bases and preserve unresolved reduced-staff magnitudes. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: An unnumbered time signature applies to all staves and prints by default.
dispositions.produces: Effective time scope is all staves in the part unless number selects one; print-object defaults to yes.
dispositions.closure: Support compound beats and multiple beat-unit pairs without reducing them to one numeric numerator. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Senza-misura explicitly removes metrical measure interpretation.
dispositions.produces: A senza-misura time context has no fixed meter and ignores time symbol.
dispositions.closure: Disable meter-derived fill assumptions without discarding note timing. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Transposition adds to written pitch and defaults to part-wide staff scope.
dispositions.produces: Sounding pitch is written pitch plus chromatic and separate octave-change contributions; absent number applies the transpose to all staves.
dispositions.closure: Keep diatonic spelling and chromatic pitch contributions distinct and add octave-change separately. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Left-first and right-last barline placement is recommended, with exceptions and a conflicting example.
dispositions.closure: Resolve the attributes-before-left-barline example before suggesting an order repair; retain advisory severity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Times and after-jump are meaningful on backward repeats outside endings.
dispositions.produces: Repeat times and after-jump are active only for backward repeat outside an ending.
dispositions.closure: Decide inactive-field diagnostic policy without inventing a schema prohibition. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Barre endpoints follow string pitch ordering rather than frame-note XML order.
dispositions.produces: Barre start denotes the lower-pitched, higher-numbered string and stop the higher-pitched string.
dispositions.closure: Use string identity and pitch orientation instead of requiring XML start-before-stop. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Bass alteration is printed to the right unless specified otherwise.
dispositions.produces: Effective bass-alter location is right when absent; print-object=no can suppress a sign already represented in bass-step text.
dispositions.closure: Separate semantic alteration from its visible sign and local text representation. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Bracket lines are solid unless explicitly styled differently.
dispositions.produces: Effective bracket line-type is solid when absent; end-length sizes the jog for up or down line ends.
dispositions.closure: Evaluate end-length only with a jog-producing line-end. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Degree alteration uses different reference scales for add versus alter or subtract.
dispositions.produces: Degree-alter is relative to the kind's degree for alter or subtract and to dominant with minor seventh for add; plus-minus defaults to no.
dispositions.closure: Specify the reference interval for each degree operation without checking harmony against sounding notes. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Degree text follows an explicit degree-value symbol without replacing its numeric meaning.
dispositions.produces: When degree-value symbol is present its text is appended after the symbol and its content still identifies the degree number.
dispositions.closure: Keep graphical text composition separate from the degree's numeric identity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Direction-to-note association follows musical time and compatible voice rather than neighboring XML.
dispositions.produces: A note-associated direction selects the first following note in musical order that is not in another voice.
dispositions.closure: Resolve unspecified voices and equal-time candidate ties before finalizing the association algorithm. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Direction children inherit preceding nonpositional formatting while retaining distinct coordinates.
dispositions.produces: Sequential direction-type content inherits applicable nonpositional formatting from preceding content but does not inherit coordinate fields through this rule.
dispositions.closure: Enumerate inheritable attributes and reset boundaries before closing the inheritance contract. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Rehearsal text has local default enclosure, language, and justification.
dispositions.produces: Effective rehearsal defaults are enclosure=square, language=it, and justify=left.
dispositions.closure: Allow section-name text as well as letters and numbers while applying explicit overrides. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Words has local default enclosure, language, and justification.
dispositions.produces: Effective words defaults are enclosure=none, language=it, and justify=left.
dispositions.closure: Apply each fallback only when its corresponding field is absent. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Specialized notation is preferred over generic symbol when semantic markup exists.
dispositions.closure: Retain the markup recommendation and separately preserve canonical SMuFL naming plus justify=left and enclosure=none defaults. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A missing first-fret places the top frame cell at fret one.
dispositions.produces: The top frame cell denotes fret one when first-fret is absent; text and location change its label rather than its fret number.
dispositions.closure: Separate displayed first-fret labeling from actual fret identity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: The symbol for an unplayed frame string is application-selected when unplayed is absent.
dispositions.produces: For a string without frame-note, missing unplayed yields application-dependent unknown display.
dispositions.closure: Do not reduce the open symbol domain to x or empty text. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Frame notes distinguish open strings from omitted muted strings.
dispositions.produces: Fret zero represents an open string; a muted string is represented by absence of frame-note for that string.
dispositions.closure: Do not require a frame-note for every frame string. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Stop-group feature content can be ignored while group identity supports overlap and hierarchies.
dispositions.produces: Grouping stop features may be inactive; number distinguishes groups and member-of identifies their hierarchy.
dispositions.closure: Preserve overlap and hierarchy identity rather than forcing stack-only grouping. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Local harmony formatting supersedes the enclosing harmony print style.
dispositions.produces: A harmony child's explicit formatting overrides general harmony print-style, while arrangement controls stacked-chord placement.
dispositions.closure: Keep graphical precedence independent of harmonic correctness against notes. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: D, C, B, E, F, G, A is a recommended readable harp pedal order.
dispositions.closure: Preserve other schema-valid pedal orders without mandatory failure. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Unspecified degree-stacking and enclosure choices belong to the application.
dispositions.produces: Missing stack-degrees, parentheses-degrees, and bracket-degrees resolve to application-dependent unknown.
dispositions.closure: Retain the separate suggestion to hide a degree already written in kind text. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Repeated listening child types should distinguish their player or repeat-pass targets.
dispositions.closure: Evaluate overlapping player and pass scopes for advice rather than using raw child count. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A listening offset overrides its parent direction's offset and changes later playback-time behavior.
dispositions.produces: Effective listening position uses listening offset over direction offset, with subsequent scope in performance time.
dispositions.closure: Keep score position separate from hardware latency compensation. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Implicit measures suppress numbering before text or number selection.
dispositions.produces: Implicit=yes suppresses numbering; otherwise measure text overrides number, reference staff defaults to one, and multiple-rest numbering fields require numbering other than none.
dispositions.closure: Decompose suppression, label choice, staff fallback, and multiple-rest field activity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Metronome parentheses are absent by default and print-object can hide the mark.
dispositions.produces: Effective metronome parentheses is no when absent; print-object=no suppresses rendering without removing the metric relation.
dispositions.closure: Retain semantic metronome content even when the mark is not printed. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Separate metronome-note start and stop elements are the recommended visual tie encoding.
dispositions.closure: Do not import every sounding-note tie restriction into the metronome rendering context. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Numeral alteration appears on the left by default.
dispositions.produces: Effective numeral-alter location is left when absent; print-object can suppress only its visible sign.
dispositions.closure: Preserve the underlying alteration when its graphical sign is hidden. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A numeral-root without text has an application-selected visual representation.
dispositions.produces: Missing numeral-root text yields application-dependent unknown display for its existing numeric degree.
dispositions.closure: Do not require Roman or Nashville notation as the default. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Octave-shift size counts the conventional interval label rather than semitone distance.
dispositions.produces: Octave-shift size eight denotes one octave and size fifteen denotes two octaves of display shift relative to note pitch.
dispositions.closure: Unify these examples with the size-default provider without closing the positive-integer domain. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Offset has measure-local musical origin and distinct sound and visual precedence.
dispositions.produces: Offset is relative to the current position in the current measure; sound defaults to no, sound=yes applies it to sound and listening, and object default-x overrides visual offset.
dispositions.closure: Resolve the current measure cursor and separate sound activity from visual positioning. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Pedal sign defaults depend on line, and other pedal fields activate conditionally.
dispositions.produces: Sign defaults to yes for line=no and no for line=yes; abbreviated requires sign=yes and start or sostenuto, while alignment is inactive for sign=no.
dispositions.closure: Resolve the line fallback and separate sign, abbreviated, and alignment conditions before closing this provider. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Per-minute overrides its parent font and permits text beyond a pure BPM number.
dispositions.produces: Explicit per-minute font takes precedence over metronome font; per-minute content remains text.
dispositions.closure: Do not impose numeric BPM grammar on per-minute text. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Analysis-only principal voice prefers none, while a visible stop prefers plain.
dispositions.closure: Retain these rendering recommendations without rejecting other analysis text. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Print layout overrides are local and part names change at a system boundary.
dispositions.produces: Print page, system, and staff layout applies only to its current scope, after which defaults supply layout; part-name-display changes from the current or next new system.
dispositions.closure: Resolve the current-versus-next-system boundary for name changes and distinguish every layout scope. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Root alteration appears on the right by default.
dispositions.produces: Effective root-alter location is right when absent; print-object=no may suppress a sign already included in root-step text.
dispositions.closure: Keep alteration meaning separate from duplicate visible text suppression. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Tempo and dynamics have defined units but no default tempo.
dispositions.produces: Sound tempo is quarter notes per minute and dynamics is percent of MIDI forte velocity 90; missing tempo remains unspecified.
dispositions.closure: Keep the suggestion to ask for tempo when tempo=0 advisory rather than inventing a fallback value. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Navigation jumps have default passes that explicit time-only can override.
dispositions.produces: Dacapo and dalsegno default to the first pass, tocoda to the second, and time-only overrides those passes; segno and coda names select targets.
dispositions.closure: Resolve named targets and explicit pass filters before applying navigation defaults. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Fine specifies the final event's actual duration or preserves it when yes.
dispositions.produces: Fine follows the last note or rest; numeric fine supplies its actual final duration and yes leaves that duration unchanged.
dispositions.closure: Confirm numeric units and endpoint association without demanding cross-part duration equality. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Sound pizzicato continues over later notes while note pizzicato is local.
dispositions.produces: Sound pizzicato=yes enables pizzicato for subsequent notes and no restores arco; note pizzicato affects only that note.
dispositions.closure: Define the containing-part and instrument scope of persistent playback state. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Related playback changes should be grouped by instrument ID for readability and interoperability.
dispositions.closure: Retain grouping as advice without treating a different ordering as schema-invalid. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Local sound timing and MIDI instrument spatial data override older parent-level values.
dispositions.produces: Sound offset overrides direction offset; midi-instrument pan and elevation override deprecated sound pan and elevation.
dispositions.closure: Separate these precedence rules from the advice against latency compensation through musical offset. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Stick graphics omit parentheses and dashed circle by default.
dispositions.produces: Effective stick parentheses and dashed-circle are no when absent.
dispositions.closure: Apply explicit graphical overrides without assigning playback effects. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Reduced integer swing ratios are preferred but equivalent unreduced ratios remain valid.
dispositions.closure: Offer normalization only as advice and preserve equivalent ratios such as six to four. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Swing excludes grace and rhythmically nonnominal notes and runs before attack and release adjustment.
dispositions.produces: Swing defaults to eighth and applies only to nongrace notes with type whose duration equals that type's nominal value; attack and release follow swing adjustment.
dispositions.closure: Resolve dots, tuplets, and exact nominal-duration comparison before finalizing swing eligibility. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Missing synchronization mode leaves playback following behavior to the application.
dispositions.produces: Absent sync yields application-dependent unknown mode; latency uses milliseconds and player or time-only narrows scope.
dispositions.closure: Do not invent a synchronization mode or treat its absence as a file error. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Wedge field activity depends on the span's start type and open or closed endpoint.
dispositions.produces: Spread is inactive at crescendo start and diminuendo end; niente is active only at the closed end, with niente=no and line-type=solid defaults.
dispositions.closure: Resolve each stop to its start before determining endpoint type and field activity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Encoder type can distinguish multiple contribution roles without creating a closed role vocabulary.
dispositions.closure: Do not require type for a single encoder or reject extension roles. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Creator type is recommended even for one creator and role names remain extensible.
dispositions.closure: Keep role guidance advisory and permit roles beyond composer, lyricist, and arranger. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Supports metadata helps interpret missing beam, stem, or accidental data.
dispositions.closure: Retain reporting advice and avoid absence-based defects when encoder capability is unknown. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A glyph's semantic use should match its declared type where SMuFL context is available.
dispositions.closure: Keep semantic glyph matching advisory and unresolved without the external glyph catalogue. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Measure-layout applies only to the measure containing it.
dispositions.produces: Effective measure-layout overrides are local to the current measure and do not become persistent attribute state.
dispositions.closure: Reset the override at the measure boundary rather than carrying it forward. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Measure-distance describes special within-system spacing rather than ordinary measure width.
dispositions.produces: Measure-distance supplies extra internal system separation, while measure width controls ordinary measure width.
dispositions.closure: Keep coda-style separation distinct from routine measure sizing. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Print page layout is a current-page override with defaults and then application fallback.
dispositions.produces: Effective current-page fields use print/page-layout, then defaults/page-layout, then application-dependent unknown.
dispositions.closure: Resolve fallback independently per omitted field and discard print overrides after the current page. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Defaults page margins apply to both page sides unless type is specified.
dispositions.produces: Within defaults/page-margins, absent type means both; print page margins need no type selection.
dispositions.closure: Keep the defaults-specific fallback separate from print-local margin interpretation. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Scaling is a relation between millimeters and tenths rather than two unrelated measurements.
dispositions.produces: Scaling supplies a millimeter-to-tenths conversion relation for global layout units.
dispositions.closure: Decide zero-denominator handling as arithmetic or profile policy without fabricating a source prohibition. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Staff-layout defaults and print overrides have different lifetimes and the first system staff ignores distance.
dispositions.produces: Staff-layout number defaults to one; defaults apply to all systems and print to the current system, with staff-distance inactive on the system's first staff.
dispositions.closure: Determine the first visible system staff before applying distance activity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: System dividers have positional defaults relative to adjacent systems and margins.
dispositions.produces: Default divider position lies midway in system-distance from the lower system's top at the relevant system margin; print addresses the current-to-previous-system boundary.
dispositions.closure: Specify missing preceding-system and margin context behavior before closing the position provider. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: System spacing fields depend on page position and print overrides fall back to defaults.
dispositions.produces: System-distance is inactive for the first system on a page and top-system-distance for later systems; current print fields override defaults per field.
dispositions.closure: Resolve page-system position before selecting active spacing and fallback values. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: The application decides how inconsistent system and measure widths render.
dispositions.produces: When summed measure widths disagree with system width, effective rendering is application-dependent unknown.
dispositions.closure: Preserve the discrepancy as unresolved layout behavior rather than unconditional document invalidity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: One system-layout copy in the first visible part is sufficient.
dispositions.produces: Print/system-layout in the first visible part supplies the system context without required copies in other parts.
dispositions.closure: Identify visible-part order before selecting the authoritative system layout source. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Signed system margins modify page margins in opposite directions.
dispositions.produces: Negative system margins reduce the page margin and positive system margins increase the inset.
dispositions.closure: Preserve signed values and do not impose universal nonnegative margins. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Relative links in compressed MusicXML resolve from the archive root.
dispositions.produces: The base for a relative link inside MXL is the ZIP root, not the directory of the containing score entry.
dispositions.closure: Keep archive traversal defenses as separate security policy rather than changing this URI base. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Accidental editorial and cautionary flags default to no and do not define pitch alteration.
dispositions.produces: Effective accidental editorial and cautionary are no when absent; the printed accidental remains separate from pitch alter.
dispositions.closure: Preserve explicit pitch data independently of accidental display flags. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: An ornament accidental is positioned from its ornament rather than the note.
dispositions.produces: The layout origin for accidental-mark within ornament is the ornament's position.
dispositions.closure: Do not apply the ornament-origin rule to accidental-mark in other parents. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: An arpeggio without direction runs upward and number distinguishes related marks.
dispositions.produces: Effective arpeggio direction is low-to-high when absent; number associates coordinated or separate arpeggiation marks.
dispositions.closure: Do not require the optional unbroken cross-staff rendering hint. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: An arrow glyph should agree with the arrow's structural description.
dispositions.closure: Retain advisory glyph consistency and distinguish an arrowhead from a complete shafted arrow. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Assessment is recommended for ordinary notes and skipped for cue notes by default.
dispositions.closure: Keep assessment choice advisory while preserving absent player and time-only as all-player and all-pass scope. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Positive backup duration is described as recommended but is already mandatory in the schema.
dispositions.closure: Link the positive-divisions schema predicate and avoid a duplicate prose-level mandatory finding. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Backup is recommended not to cross a measure boundary or divisions change.
dispositions.closure: Keep boundary guidance advisory and do not derive meter-fill equality from it. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Beam number is a beam level rather than a unique group identifier.
dispositions.produces: Beam identity uses voice and grace or cue context, while number selects the level and up to eight levels serve 1024th notes.
dispositions.closure: Resolve the older beam-level wording conflict and define grouping across same-voice note sequences. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Fan behavior belongs to beam starts and certain continuations rather than every beam endpoint.
dispositions.produces: Beam fan defaults to none and is applicable at begin or a direction-changing continue; repeater=yes must be explicit on each beam using it.
dispositions.closure: Specify direction-change recognition and retain the legacy repeater clause separately from fan activity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A note that bends and then releases is encoded with two ordered bend elements, which is stronger than a display default.
dispositions.closure: Decompose the bend-then-release condition, two-bend cardinality, and order predicate; distinguish pre-bend and negative bend values before authorizing any failure. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Explicit elision text takes precedence over a glyph name and otherwise display can remain application-defined.
dispositions.produces: Nonempty elision text overrides smufl; if neither supplies a symbol, effective display is application-dependent unknown.
dispositions.closure: Preserve text-over-glyph precedence without requiring smufl for textual elision. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Figured-bass prefix supports style-specific symbols beyond the listed examples.
dispositions.produces: Figured-bass prefix remains an open string domain with examples rather than a closed accidental enumeration.
dispositions.closure: Do not create an enum from the plus and accidental examples. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Figure-number expresses a number but its accepted numeric lexical grammar is not specified.
dispositions.closure: Decide the exact numeric predicate and treatment of textual variants before defining a regex; preserve suffix as the crossing mechanism. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Figured-bass suffix is extensible and can specify a stroke crossing the figure.
dispositions.produces: Suffix remains an open style-dependent string domain; slash, back-slash, and vertical can cross the displayed number.
dispositions.closure: Keep crossing behavior for known values without restricting extension values. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Figured bass anchors to a subsequent ordinary note and can change within its duration.
dispositions.produces: The anchor is the first following nongrace, nonchord note in score order; figures are ordered top to bottom and parentheses defaults to no.
dispositions.closure: Resolve no-anchor cases and multiple in-note duration segments before closing attachment semantics. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Positive forward duration is already mandatory through the schema even though this prose is advisory.
dispositions.closure: Reuse the positive-divisions schema predicate rather than duplicating it as a prose error. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Forward is recommended not to cross measure boundaries or divisions changes.
dispositions.closure: Keep boundary advice distinct from an unsupported requirement to fill every voice to a full measure. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Glissando and slide have different line and pitch-continuity defaults.
dispositions.produces: Glissando defaults to a wavy line and distinct intermediate sounds; slide defaults to solid and continuous pitch movement.
dispositions.closure: Keep graphical line style and musical continuity as separate derived properties. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Grace timing uses neighboring-note percentages or added divisions instead of ordinary duration.
dispositions.produces: Steal-time-previous and steal-time-following are percentages of the respective neighboring note; make-time adds time in divisions.
dispositions.closure: Resolve the relevant neighbors and do not synthesize ordinary duration from its allowed absence. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: An empty hammer-on or pull-off leaves the printed designation to the application.
dispositions.produces: Missing textual content yields application-dependent unknown marking, while each hammer-on or pull-off span connects its own two notes.
dispositions.closure: Keep these local pairs distinct from any encompassing longer slur. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Organ heel and toe substitution flags default to no.
dispositions.produces: Effective heel and toe substitution is no when absent.
dispositions.closure: Do not derive a required numerical fingering from heel or toe notation. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: A hole is circular by default and location applies to half-closed states.
dispositions.produces: Effective hole shape is circle when hole-shape is absent; location is active for half-closed holes.
dispositions.closure: Separate shape fallback from the state-dependent location field. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Notes in a multi-instrument part are recommended to identify their instrument.
dispositions.closure: Preserve MusicXML 4.0 support for multiple instrument elements rather than enforcing an obsolete single-instrument limit. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

dispositions.rationale: Same-type listen children on a note should differ in player or repeat-pass scope.
